name: bb10-volte
scope: All 16 catalog entries admit Mobile 460-00/07, Unicom 460-01 and Telecom 460-11 regardless of evidence status. Root, OS 10.3.3.3216, native ABI hashes, SIM identity, backup and recovery requirements remain. r44/mobile 0.1.0.44 lets an admitted model with no dedicated migration path start fresh when every known legacy service directory is absent. Unknown models and any known legacy install stay blocked, and another suffix's recovery path is never reused. Previously published r42/r43 service payloads remain eligible for their existing checked upgrade. Historical tested, untested and known-issue results stay version-specific. This release does not claim new call, audio, SMS or data acceptance. macOS remains the frozen r43 build.
